dataset_provenance: SQuAD2 public dev set, originally crowdworker-annotated Wikipedia; original authors and contributors credited at https://rajpurkar.github.io/SQuAD-explorer/. Raw SHA256=80a5225e94905956a6446d296ca1093975c4d3b3260f1d6c8f68bc2ab77182d8. Adaptation: normalized contexts, paragraph retrieval judgments, article-family hash split, up to 6 paragraphs/article and 2 answerable questions/paragraph. This is a new diagnostic split, not an official SQuAD leaderboard evaluation. Adaptation and corpus-wide relevance pooling have not been independently reviewed. Original no-answer annotations are passage-scoped and excluded because they are not corpus-wide no-answer labels.

leakage_audit.method: casefolded word 5-shingles; Jaccard>=0.8 or containment>=0.9 with >=8 shingles
leakage_audit.limitations: Lexical audit cannot establish absence of semantic leakage. Shared facts require review but are not automatically the same source family.

latency_protocol.reported_percentiles: all repeated in-process API requests; includes snapshot writes

limitations: These results measure only this dataset; inspect review_status and provenance before making quality claims.
Source-separated evaluation uses an isolated corpus for each partition; it is not a mixed-corpus production benchmark.
Lexical near-duplicate and shared-fact auditing cannot detect all semantic leakage; manual review is required.
Candidate rankers may be evaluated explicitly; a successful evaluation alone is not production promotion.
Heuristic ranking scores are not probabilities; calibration/Brier metrics are intentionally omitted.
Bootstrap resamples connected source-family clusters; fewer than five independent families suppress the interval.
Latency uses seeded shuffled mode order and repeated warm in-process API requests, not deployed-network latency.
Citation integrity checks provenance, not whether an excerpt entails an answer.
